adoptionSource: Adopted by the operator on 2026-10-28 ("go ahead and register the tasks, adopt contract and move to /kbd-execute"). Scenarios were proposed by kbd-plan and value-scenario-discovery; budgets are estimates, not measurements. Four Claude decisions remain flagged in releaseClaim.explicitUnknowns and were not individually confirmed.

releaseClaim.userOperation: a host applies agent-produced A2UI surfaces from an AG-UI 1.0 stream with no loss, rollback or duplicate effect under redelivery, incremental update, reconnect and multiple tabs
releaseClaim.currentCapabilities: a2ui-react 4.2.0 handles only ACTIVITY_SNAPSHOT, deletes and recreates surfaces on redelivery, enforces no resource caps, and has no headless entry, versioned deltas or global action ids
explicitUnknowns: whether the draft-spec statements on replace default and MESSAGES_SNAPSHOT hold in @ag-ui/core 1.0.3
limit defaults are provisional and unmeasured
digest canonical form, tombstone and buffer sizes and the resync wire shape are decided during implementation
whether the new example package must be registered in examples/coverage.json
gate commands are fixed only when scenarios are authored
AUI-10..12 apply only if a2ui-headless-export proceeds
ownerTask IDs (a2ui-hardening-acceptance#7, the run task) must match canonical task IDs once changes are registered; runId is the active canonical run, named for the earlier phase that started it

action emission for executed v0.9.1 actions, the new example package, the Flutter-contract documentation section and the existing-gate expectation edits are Claude decisions awaiting operator confirmation

scenarioMatrix.name: Duplicate create activity is a no-op
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: lab producer redelivers a create activity to a real Chromium page running PrometheusA2uiRuntime
scenarioMatrix.oracle: held surface and typed input unchanged
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: same epoch and version with a different digest: first kept, producer fault reported
scenarioMatrix.evidence: pending: receipt path, source identity, exit code

scenarioMatrix.name: Duplicate and out-of-order versioned updates
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: lab producer redelivers and reorders versioned update activities
scenarioMatrix.oracle: nothing already applied changes and typed input survives
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: a stale version under a new messageId is also ignored

scenarioMatrix.name: MESSAGES_SNAPSHOT replay keeps surface and input
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: lab producer replays a thread via MESSAGES_SNAPSHOT while the user has typed input
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: snapshot omitting the activity does not delete the surface; redelivered createSurface after deleteSurface does not resurrect it

scenarioMatrix.name: Newer restatement applies as updates
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: lab producer sends a newer replace:true restatement after the user edited a bound input
scenarioMatrix.oracle: unchanged producer values never overwrite typed input; the final value follows producer-wins and the conflict is reported
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: a surface omitted from the restatement survives
scenarioMatrix.evidence: pending: final data model value and conflict event

scenarioMatrix.name: Two concurrent streams, one activity
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: lab producer delivers one activity over two streams, including one surface version under two messageIds
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: same key with a different digest: first kept

scenarioMatrix.name: Versioned delta, gap and refusal
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: lab producer streams deltas, skips a version, and sends a batch the runtime refuses
scenarioMatrix.oracle: ordered apply; gap or missing snapshot triggers a resync request; refused batch reports the validation error
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: a delta introducing a component outside the allowlist is rejected with the surface unchanged; a versionless delta is rejected

scenarioMatrix.name: Held-version report on reconnect
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: page reconnects and reports held versions to the lab producer
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: limitation: the producer is repo code, so this proves the runtime's report only

scenarioMatrix.name: Distinct actionIds across contexts and reload
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: two browser contexts and a reload each dispatch actions to the lab producer
scenarioMatrix.oracle: distinct actionIds at the producer; the runtime retry API reuses one
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: two distinct actions never share an id

scenarioMatrix.name: Envelope fidelity
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: a real browser action for v0.9.1 and v1, with and without sendDataModel
scenarioMatrix.oracle: the envelope the producer received matches the declared shape
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: missing data model when sendDataModel is set fails

scenarioMatrix.name: Export is a fixed point (conditional)
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: headless runtime in a real Node process exports a surface, loads it into a fresh runtime and exports again
scenarioMatrix.oracle: both exports identical including v1 action responses
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: an export losing rootId or catalogId fails

scenarioMatrix.name: Headless and React runtimes agree (conditional)
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: the same message corpus through the headless entry and the browser runtime
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: corpus includes allowlist and limit violations

scenarioMatrix.name: Unreachable components pruned (conditional)
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: headless export of a surface with orphaned components
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: a reachable component is never pruned

scenarioMatrix.name: Release records match the registry
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: comparison of release status files, both changelogs and bridge pins with npm view output
scenarioMatrix.oracle: all agree; no claim about product behavior
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: a stale pin fails; the tag part is NOT_EXERCISED until approved

scenarioMatrix.name: Stale-action rejection operations are applied
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: lab producer rejects a stale action and returns operations since the held version
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: a rejection with no operations triggers a resync request

resilienceScope.policy: AUI-3 (replay and resurrection), the allowlist and limit negative controls on every path, and the typed-input preservation guarantees never defer via budget overflow; exhaustion means checkpoint and BLOCKED. AUI-13 is delivery-only and not product evidence.

exclusions: tagging or publishing without operator approval
requiredSafetyChecks: trust boundary: agent-generated UI to the catalog and component allowlist and the resource limits, on every path
scratch ports and directories removed by the gate runner
one machine-wide build at a time

budgets.exhaustion: checkpoint and BLOCKED; never silent PASS

extensions.scope: phase close after the observed consumption of the hardening phase: wall clock 342 min (measured), 13 repair attempts (estimate, counted from the phase record), tool calls 386 and rising; ceilings raised to cover completing the phase, no scope added
wall-clock only: measured time since dispatch reached 691 min because it counts waiting, docs work and the operator-run close; no scope added

evidenceInvalidation: source digest of packages/a2ui-react or examples/agui-activity-lab, plan revision, or fixture identity changes

commands: BLOCKED-UNTIL-AUTHORED: Cucumber run for the lab scenarios (a2ui-hardening-acceptance#6)
BLOCKED-UNTIL-AUTHORED: Playwright run with the lab example config (a2ui-hardening-acceptance#6)
BLOCKED-UNTIL-AUTHORED: headless Node run for AUI-10..12 if a2ui-headless-export proceeds
expectedEffects: scratch ports and directories created and removed
no change to published packages, tags or the registry
boundaryPacket.requiredApprovals: operator adoption of this contract before any dependent generation; separate approval for any tag or publish
receipts: local receipt per scenario with source identity, exit code and observed result
